Dr. Reddy's to distribute Takeda's dengue vaccine in India from 2027

Dr. Reddy's Laboratories has partnered with Takeda, a Japanese pharmaceutical company, to distribute Takeda's dengue vaccine, Qdenga, in India. The vaccine is expected to enter the Indian market in 2027. This marks the introduction of India's first dengue vaccine. Following the announcement, shares of Dr. Reddy's rose by 2%.
